area: anchor suppression blocks the trend it should follow
breaks: the counter-trend trap filter inverts: blue dots are suppressed when the higher-timeframe anchor is strongly BULLISH and allowed when it is strongly bearish — the filter now removes exactly the entries it exists to keep

area: the gold dot fires on one condition instead of three
breaks: gold is the rarest and most important marker on this indicator and its whole meaning is CONFLUENCE. At K=1 it fires on nearly every blue dot, so the one signal that says 'several things agree' starts saying 'something happened'

area: the N-bar confirmation requires the opposite of what it confirms
breaks: ConfirmBars exists so a blue dot needs WT to have been BELOW oversold for the preceding bars; inverted, it demands WT was above it, so the confirmation gate passes exactly when the setup did not happen
audit: Caught only by a coverage/exemption BOOKKEEPING guard, which fails because the mutant changed which components produce values on the synthetic series — not because anything asserted the rule. The natural repair for that failure is to edit the pinned list, which restores green and leaves the defect.

area: one shallow pivot is deep enough for a divergence
breaks: the depth gate is what separates a divergence from two shallow wiggles with price drift; with OR, any pair where either leg happens to be deep qualifies

area: LOOK-AHEAD: shallow divergences are shifted to a bar where they did not happen
breaks: the documented exemption removed. The shallow detector stamps at the WT CROSSOVER bar and is already causal; shifting it moves every shallow bull divergence — a strategy leaf, an earcon and a spoken marker — pivotBars LATER than the market event it describes

area: a WT pivot no longer needs to be a local extreme
breaks: the pivot test stops being 'lowest in the window' and becomes an arbitrary comparison against a doubled value, which for negative WT values inverts across zero — every divergence in the indicator is built on these pivots

area: the Money Flow wave leaves its pane
breaks: the clamp that keeps the MF wave inside the WT pane's +/-100 bounds stops clamping, so on extreme-body runs the wave rescales the whole pane and every other component in it flattens — the auto-fit axis is shared

area: the adaptive oversold floor becomes a ceiling
breaks: MinThresholdFloor exists to stop the adaptive threshold collapsing toward zero in a compressed regime, which is when whipsaw is worst; Max instead of Min pins it AT the floor and the adaptation stops happening in the one regime it was added for

area: LOOK-AHEAD: a daily bar reads a week that has not closed
breaks: the whole point of CompletedBucketAt is that at bar i the most recent weekly value available is the last one whose bucket has CLOSED. Taking the current bucket unconditionally feeds every daily bar a weekly RSI and regime computed from bars later in the same week

area: LOOK-AHEAD: an unfinished bucket is forward-filled anyway
breaks: the second half of the same guard: a bucket straddling a data gap, or the trailing running one, has a close that is not yet known, and this lets its value be carried onto bars before it exists

area: the ADX lookback window becomes the whole chart
breaks: 'ADX cleared the gate at some point in the last N bars' becomes 'at any point in recorded history', so the trend-strength gate passes permanently after the first strong trend the series ever had

area: the hold-down between markers stops holding
breaks: holdDownBars exists so one choppy midline region does not emit a burst of long triggers; without it the same cycle fires repeatedly and the cluster earcon becomes a rattle

area: a long entry is allowed in a bear regime
breaks: regime is one of only three orthogonal gates left on the v2 long after the 2026-04-09 walk-forward stripped the others; widened to >= -0.5 it admits the neutral AND bull states, so the gate that says 'price structure agrees' stops disagreeing with anything but a hard bear

area: Wilder smoothing on the weekly RSI becomes a different average
breaks: the multi-timeframe anchor RSI stops being an RSI: the recursion no longer decays, so avgGain grows without bound and the weekly anchor drifts to 100 and stays there

area: the midline cross fires while sitting on the midline
breaks: a bar that opens and closes exactly at the midline is now a cross, so a flat series pinned at the midline emits a bull cross on every bar

area: the oversold state no longer has to be sustained
breaks: a single bar dipping past the oversold line now counts as a sustained oversold condition, so the markers gated on it fire on one-bar spikes

area: LOOK-AHEAD: the support/resistance zone appears before its pivot exists
breaks: a pivot at bar i needs bars i+1..i+pb to BE a pivot; confirming at i draws the zone line up to 15 bars before it exists and a strategy comparing price to that level reads a number derived from bars it has not seen — the exact defect fixed on 2026-08-21

area: a resistance level breaks on a touch instead of a convincing close past it
breaks: the break threshold moves to the wrong side of the level, so a close still BELOW resistance invalidates it — every zone is destroyed by the first bar that approaches it

area: a pivot high tolerates an equal high beside it
breaks: 'strictly greatest in the window' becomes 'greatest or equal', so a flat top or a doubled high emits two adjacent resistance pivots instead of none

area: sideways noise pattern-matches as a top
breaks: the gate inverts: distribution evidence is now admitted ONLY in flat chop and blocked during a real rally, which is precisely backwards from the comment that says why the gate exists

area: 'at the top of the range' means at the bottom of it
breaks: the positional gate on every distribution stream inverts, so a top is detected when price sits in the lower four-fifths of its own trailing range
audit: Caught only by a coverage/exemption BOOKKEEPING guard, which fails because the mutant changed which components produce values on the synthetic series — not because anything asserted the rule. The natural repair for that failure is to edit the pinned list, which restores green and leaves the defect.

area: a capitulation bottom re-fires on every bar of the same event
breaks: the rising-edge test is what makes this a marker rather than a state: without it a capitulation lasting eight bars stamps eight bottoms, and the earcon fires eight times for one event

area: the cycle window is re-detected on every recalculation
breaks: the 1.5x staleness margin is what stops the auto-detector re-running (and re-announcing) on every tick; at a bare inequality any growth in the series re-detects, so the chart narrates a new cycle window continuously

area: every trivial change in the detected cycle is announced
breaks: the significance threshold is what keeps this from speaking on noise; at 0 a one-bar shift in the median trough interval produces a full spoken sentence

area: LOOK-AHEAD: the Chikou span is plotted forward instead of back
breaks: Chikou is the close plotted DISPLACEMENT bars BEHIND — that is the entire definition, and it is why it can be compared to past price. Plotted forward, every bar shows a close from 26 bars in the future: a look-ahead that reads as a beautifully predictive line

area: the Tenkan/Kijun cross loses its confirmation bar
breaks: the 2-bar confirmation is dropped, so a cross that immediately reverses still stamps a bullish marker

area: the anchor pivot stops being a pivot
breaks: a swing high is only a swing high because the bars AFTER it are lower; checking only the bars before turns every new high into an anchor, so the VWAP re-anchors on the way up and the level the user is measuring against never settles

area: the VWAP's typical price drops the close
breaks: HLC3 is the definition of the price a VWAP is volume-weighting; the midpoint ignores where the bar actually closed, so the level drifts away from the traded average it claims to be

area: the Hurst exponent is computed on price differences instead of log returns
breaks: rescaled-range analysis is scale-invariant only on log returns; on raw differences the exponent becomes a function of the asset's price level, so the same series at a different denomination reports a different regime

area: the cloud is 'expanding' on any increase at all
breaks: the 2% deadband is what stops the spoken description flipping between expanding and contracting on rounding; without it the sentence changes almost every bar

area: a sentiment flip is announced without a previous side
breaks: the first non-neutral reading on a freshly loaded chart now stamps a FLIP, so every chart opens by announcing a sentiment change that did not occur

area: fear and greed swap sides
breaks: extreme fear reads as greed and vice versa on the one indicator whose entire output is which of those two it is

area: the spoken divergence hint says the opposite
breaks: RSI rising while price falls is the textbook BULLISH divergence; this is a sentence the user hears on the detail key, and it now names the wrong direction

area: the moving-average dispatch falls through to one type
breaks: MACloudProvider offers six MA types and the user picks one per component; HMA silently becomes SMA, so a setting that names a different calculation produces the original one

area: LOOK-AHEAD: external data is back-filled onto bars before it was published
breaks: CrossSeriesForwardFill is the one forward-fill every external series flows through — sentiment, COT positioning, funding, open interest, crowding. Without this guard the FIRST tick's value is written onto every bar before it, so a chart shows a Fear and Greed reading on dates that predate the reading

area: a flat stretch mints two intermediate cycle lows
breaks: the tie rule inverts: an equal prior daily-cycle low no longer holds the title, so one flat stretch produces two ICLs and the intermediate-cycle count — which every downstream day count is measured from — goes wrong for the rest of the chart

area: a daily cycle low no longer has to be a low
breaks: the symmetric strict-< local minimum is the ONLY selectivity this detector has (the comment records two windowed-lowest filters that were tried and removed); allowing ties means a flat base emits a DCL on each of its bars

area: an incomplete down-cycle is classified as a completed one
breaks: reachedOS is the memory of whether the down-swing actually got to oversold, and it is what separates a bull-continuation shallow trough from a genuine cycle bottom. Inverted, every completed cycle is reported as a failed one and vice versa — two different markers, two different earcons, swapped
